name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Godfrey, Cooper, and Kingsford belong to different artisans.

Aldric goes with exactly one of Blacksmith, Carpenter, or Oldwall.
Blacksmith goes with at least one of Aldric, Godfrey, or Riverside.
Carpenter goes with either Godfrey or Rowan.
